Constants of the original TWINSPAN

Source: R/twinspan_hill.R
tw_hill_const.Rd

The values that Hill's FORTRAN program sets for one division. They are used when twinspan(polish = "hill"), and are collected here so that the correspondence with the original is easy to check.

Usage

tw_hill_const()

Value

A named list of the constants. rat_lim, frq_lim, feeble, icw_exp, ipr_exp, cwt_min, cr_long, cr_cut, polish_iter, mz_crit, mz_out and mz_ind.

Examples

# \donttest{
unlist(tw_hill_const())
#>     rat_lim     frq_lim      feeble     icw_exp     ipr_exp     cwt_min 
#>        3.00        0.20        0.10        1.00        4.00        0.01 
#>     cr_long      cr_cut polish_iter     mz_crit      mz_out      mz_ind 
#>        0.20        0.20        2.00        8.00        4.00        4.00 
# }
